meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动或系统结构画成动态架构图,让同事一眼看懂改了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要向同事解释代码改动却总觉得说不清。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if explaining code changes to teammates never lands the way you meant it to.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把代码改动或部分代码库画成带动画的架构图或数据流图:先写出一份 JSON 文档,再渲染成动画 SVG,可推到在线画布给出链接,或附进 PR 描述。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个改动或系统画成图、可视化或解释,或提到 PR Lens、diagram、pull request 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这个分支的代码改动画成架构图,给我画布链接
say.note: 渲染并推送画布,返回一个链接

say.text: 在已有的 PR 上附上架构图
say.note: 用 gh 把 SVG 上传进 PR 描述
在打开的画布上播放答案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a code change or part of a codebase into an animated architecture or data-flow diagram: it writes a JSON document, renders animated SVGs, then pushes them to a canvas link or attaches them to a PR.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when you mention PR Lens, diagram or pull request.

say_en.text: Diagram this branch's code change as architecture and give me the canvas link
say_en.note: Renders and pushes a canvas, returns a link

say_en.text: Attach the architecture diagram to the existing PR
say_en.note: gh uploads the SVG into the PR description

say_en.text: What is this node in the diagram?
say_en.note: Plays the answer on the open canvas
